name: imovies
description: IMovies - Movie ticket booking made simple

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
